name: api-key
args: where is the API key read from the environment
expect: Lines in sys1grep.mjs that read the key: the SYS1GREP_API_KEY / TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variables or the --sys1-api-key option. Not lines that merely mention a key in a comment about something else.

name: localhost-only
args: where does the server bind only to the local machine
expect: The listen call on 127.0.0.1 (and the Host check that only accepts 127.0.0.1 / localhost).

name: cost-guard
args: what asks before spending money on a large search
expect: The --max-cost check: estimating the price of the input tokens and asking to continue (askToContinue, MAX_COST, -y).

name: child-process
args: code that starts another program as a child process
expect: Calls that start a child process: execFileSync / execFile / spawn, mostly of git, also of the summarizer TOOL and of sys1grep itself.

name: no-answer
args: how is the database connection pool configured
expect: Nothing: the repository has no database. No match is the right answer; a confident hit would be wrong.

name: readme-install
expect: The install section: npm / npx / git clone commands to get sys1grep.

name: ja-templates
args: HTML のテンプレートはどこに置くか

name: changelog-rank
expect: The Added entry that introduces --rank (best first, numbered headers).

name: and-not
args: adds a warning or hint printed on stderr
expect: Changelog lines about a warning or hint on stderr, and none that mention --dedup.
